audience: vehicle rental operators that run their site on Elite EXTRA

useCases.title: Look up dealers and drivers
useCases.text: List the dealers and the drivers of the site. Open one driver to read the records linked to it.

useCases.title: Review the fleet and vehicle rates
useCases.text: List the vehicles and the vehicle rates. Open one vehicle to see its dealer and rate.

useCases.title: Track order status changes
useCases.text: List order status records. With recents set, the reply holds only the changes since the last request.

useCases.title: Check returns and return reasons
useCases.text: List the reasons a return can carry, then open one return by id.

useCases.title: Find a customer record
useCases.text: List the customer records of the site, then open one customer by id.
